caption_L2L3: I don't know what DTP4 is.  The description that the chart is "by vaccine" suggests we ought to be comparing different vaccines, but there's no sign of this.  We see no vaccination prior to 2015, then very thorough vaccination from 2015 to 2017.  Since I don't know what DTP4 means I can't be sure but it looks as though 1.0 is the maximum achievable, and the vaccination rate for those years is very close to the maximum.
